events.mission.text.terms:
1. This promotion is open only to me77 Malaysia registered users with valid and verified accounts (KYC completed).

2. Daily Missions refresh automatically at 00:00 (GMT+8) every day. Missions must be completed within the same day.

3. Weekly Missions will be settled and refreshed every Sunday at 23:59:59 (GMT+8). Missions must be completed within the same week and will not be carried over to the next week.

4. Monthly Missions will be settled and refreshed on the last day of each month at 23:59:59 (GMT+8). Missions must be completed within the same month and will not be carried forward.

5. One-Time Missions: Missions labeled as “One-Time” may only be completed or claimed once per player, and cannot be repeated.

6. Top-Up Missions:
　・Each top-up must meet the minimum amount listed on the mission page.

7. Betting Missions:
　・Only valid bets from specified game providers or game categories (Slots, Live Casino, Arcade, Sports, Fishing) will be counted.
　・Players must complete the required betting target listed on the mission page before claiming rewards.

8. Binding Missions:
　・Players must complete the required binding task as stated on the mission page.
　・The binding must be successful before the reward can be claimed.

9. All missions must be completed according to the conditions listed on the mission page. Missions not fully completed will be considered incomplete.

10. All cash rewards are subject to a 7× turnover requirement before withdrawal can be requested.

11. The maximum withdrawal limit is based on the deposit status on the reward claim date:
 ・At least 1 deposit of RM30 or above on that day: RM177
 ・No deposit of RM30 or above on that day: RM77
  ・Any deposit made after the reward claim date will not change the maximum withdrawal amount, which will remain RM77.

12. Rewards will be available for claiming approximately 30 minutes after the mission is completed.

13. If the player does not manually click “Claim” within the required time, the reward will be deemed forfeited.

14. If the system detects any abuse, hedging, or irregular betting activity, me77 Malaysia reserves the right to disqualify the player and forfeit all related bonuses and winnings.

15. me77 Malaysia reserves the right to amend, suspend, or terminate this promotion at any time without prior notice.

16. In the event of a system error, technical issue, or dispute, me77 Malaysia reserves the right of final decision and interpretation.

17. All decisions related to this promotion shall be based on the official ruling of me77 Malaysia.

This policy explains how me77 Malaysia uses cookies and related technologies when you visit our platform, and your choices regarding them.
By accessing and continuing to use me77 Malaysia, you agree to the use of cookies in accordance with this policy.

Chapter 1: What Are Cookies?
Cookies are small text files stored on your device (e.g. computer, phone, tablet) that help record and recognize your browsing behavior.


Chapter 2: Why We Use Cookies
●Login authentication (account recognition)
●Preference storage (language, layout, etc.)
●Traffic analysis (user behavior tracking)
●Functionality support (pop-ups, animations)
●Marketing tracking (ad targeting and recommendations)


Chapter 3: Types of Cookies We Use
●Session Cookies (temporary)
●Persistent Cookies (saved preferences)
●Analytical Cookies (behavior analysis)
●Marketing Cookies (conversion tracking)


Chapter 4: Third-Party Cookies
We may allow trusted partners to set cookies, including advertising tools, payment providers, and analytics services.


Chapter 5: How to Manage or Delete Cookies
You can disable cookies through your browser settings (e.g. Chrome, Safari, Edge). Disabling cookies may affect some functionality.


Chapter 6: Updates and Notifications
This policy may be updated periodically. Any changes will be posted on this page.

Last Updated: September 26, 2025

site.support.text.commonProblem:
Account

Q: How do I register a me77 Malaysia account?
A: Just click [Register], fill in your username, phone number, password, and verification code. A referral code is required and will be filled in automatically. If not, feel free to contact our support team.

Q: Can I use the same phone number for multiple accounts?
A: No. Each player is allowed one account only. Accounts detected as duplicates may be restricted.

Q: What should I do if I forget my password?
A: Simply click [Forgot Password] on the login page and follow the steps to reset it. If your account is frozen, please contact support for help.

Q: What happens if multiple accounts share the same bank, IP, or device?
A: To keep things fair, we only allow one account per user. If the system finds multiple accounts using the same bank, IP, or device, restrictions may apply.


Deposits & Withdrawals

Q: What payment methods does me77 Malaysia support?
A: We support local E- Wallets, Bank Transfers, and Crypto. All payments are fast, safe, and easy to use.

Q: How long does it take to withdraw?
A: Withdrawals are usually processed within 5–30 minutes. Please make sure your bank info is correct and under your real name.

Q: What should I do if my deposit or withdrawal fails?
A: Kindly double-check your details and make sure any turnover requirements are met. If you need help, our support team is always here for you.


Daily Check In

Q: What is the Daily Check-In?
A: The Daily Check-In lets you claim free rewards every day directly from the homepage. Check in for multiple days in a row to unlock extra rewards! If you miss a day, your streak will restart from Day 1 and be recalculated. After completing 7 days, the system will automatically reset to Day 1 on the 8th day, but don’t worry — your total check-in record will still be saved.


Platform & Game Issues

Q: Why do I sometimes face errors when using the platform?
A: Due to the complexity of the platform and different user device environments, you may experience the following issues:

- Page or feature not displaying properly
- Deposit or withdrawal errors
- Login failures or disconnection
- Unexpected system error messages
- Buttons or links not responding

Don’t worry — our 24/7 technical support team is ready to help you resolve any of these issues promptly.
